definitions: A drinking glass with straight sides and no handle or stem.
An acrobat or gymnast who performs somersaults and springs.
A part of a lock that must be moved to a certain position by a key.
A breed of domestic pigeon that turns over backwards in flight.
examples: He poured water into a glass tumbler.
The circus tumbler performed a backflip.
The lock's tumblers clicked into place.
A flock of tumblers circled the loft.
